defect: logical conjunction collapses a byte write mask to one bit
rationale: enabled_bytes must preserve each enabled lane. Logical && produces only 0 or 1: lane 3 alone requested with all lanes available enables lane 0 instead, causing a write to the wrong byte.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Logical && reduces the two lane vectors to one bit which is zero-extended, so only lane 0 can ever be enabled instead of a per-lane bitwise AND.
